from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Initial Setup
        self.setup_layout("The Grand Proof", [
            "Sum the distances from P to both foci.",
            "This sum equals a fixed cone slant distance.",
            "Slant distance between spheres never changes.",
            "Thus, the total distance from P is constant.",
            "This proves the curve is a perfect ellipse."
        ])

        # Define basic geometry colors
        color_p = WHITE
        color_f1 = TEAL
        color_f2 = YELLOW
        color_plane = ORANGE
        color_cone = GREY_B
        color_sphere = GREY_D
        color_slant = PURPLE
        color_conclusion = "#FFFFFF" # Following storyboard instruction for Line 5

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Cone cross-section
        apex = self.grid["A4"]
        wall_l = Line(apex, self.grid["F2"], color=color_cone)
        wall_r = Line(apex, self.grid["F6"], color=color_cone)
        self.add(wall_l, wall_r)

        # Plane line (representing the ellipse)
        plane_start = self.grid["B3"]
        plane_end = self.grid["E5"]
        plane_line = Line(plane_start, plane_end, color=color_plane)
        self.add(plane_line)

        # Spheres (Circles tangent to walls and plane)
        # Positioned to visually approximate the tangency condition
        s1_center = self.grid["B4"] + DOWN * 0.1
        s1 = Circle(radius=0.45, color=color_sphere, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to(s1_center)
        s2_center = self.grid["D4"] + DOWN * 0.35
        s2 = Circle(radius=0.85, color=color_sphere, fill_opacity=0.3).move_to(s2_center)
        self.add(s1, s2)

        # Focal points (where spheres touch the plane)
        f1_pos = plane_line.point_from_proportion(0.2)
        f2_pos = plane_line.point_from_proportion(0.8)
        f1 = Dot(f1_pos, color=color_f1)
        f2 = Dot(f2_pos, color=color_f2)
        f1_label = MathTex("F_1", color=color_f1, font_size=20).next_to(f1, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        f2_label = MathTex("F_2", color=color_f2, font_size=20).next_to(f2, LEFT, buff=0.1)

        # Point P on the ellipse
        p_tracker = ValueTracker(0.5)
        p_dot = Dot(color=color_p)
        p_dot.add_updater(lambda d: d.move_to(plane_line.point_from_proportion(p_tracker.get_value())))
        p_label = MathTex("P", color=color_p, font_size=24)
        p_label.add_updater(lambda l: l.next_to(p_dot, UP, buff=0.1))

        # PF1 and PF2 segments
        pf1_line = always_redraw(lambda: Line(p_dot.get_center(), f1.get_center(), color=color_f1, stroke_width=4))
        pf2_line = always_redraw(lambda: Line(p_dot.get_center(), f2.get_center(), color=color_f2, stroke_width=4))

        self.lecture[0].set_color(color_f1)
        self.play(
            FadeIn(f1, f1_label, f2, f2_label, p_dot, p_label),
            Create(pf1_line),
            Create(pf2_line)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Introduce points Q1 and Q2 on the slant height (tangent points on the cone wall)
        q1_pos = wall_l.point_from_proportion(0.25)
        q2_pos = wall_l.point_from_proportion(0.75)
        q1 = Dot(q1_pos, color=color_f1)
        q2 = Dot(q2_pos, color=color_f2)
        q1_label = MathTex("Q_1", color=color_f1, font_size=20).next_to(q1, LEFT, buff=0.1)
        q2_label = MathTex("Q_2", color=color_f2, font_size=20).next_to(q2, LEFT, buff=0.1)

        # PQ1 and PQ2 as dashed segments to visualize tangent equality (PF = PQ)
        pq1_line = always_redraw(lambda: DashedLine(p_dot.get_center(), q1.get_center(), color=color_f1, dash_length=0.1))
        pq2_line = always_redraw(lambda: DashedLine(p_dot.get_center(), q2.get_center(), color=color_f2, dash_length=0.1))

        self.lecture[1].set_color(ORANGE)
        self.play(FadeIn(q1, q1_label, q2, q2_label), Create(pq1_line), Create(pq2_line))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # The distance Q1Q2 along the slant height is fixed between the two circles
        slant_segment = Line(q1_pos, q2_pos, color=color_slant, stroke_width=6)
        slant_label = MathTex("Q_1Q_2", color=color_slant, font_size=24).next_to(slant_segment, LEFT, buff=0.2)

        self.lecture[2].set_color(color_slant)
        self.play(Create(slant_segment), FadeIn(slant_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Proof formula: PF1 + PF2 = PQ1 + PQ2 = Q1Q2
        proof_formula = MathTex("PF_1 + PF_2 = PQ_1 + PQ_2 = Q_1Q_2", color=WHITE, font_size=32)
        # ISSUE 33 FIX: use F2-F6 and scale 0.8 to avoid cramping
        self.place_in_area(proof_formula, "F2", "F6", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.play(Write(proof_formula))
        
        # Animate P moving to demonstrate the sum remains constant
        self.play(p_tracker.animate.set_value(0.3), run_time=1.5, rate_func=smooth)
        self.play(p_tracker.animate.set_value(0.7), run_time=1.5, rate_func=smooth)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Concluding summary statement
        self.lecture[4].set_color(color_conclusion)
        conclusion = Text("Constant Sum = Ellipse", color=color_conclusion, font_size=32)
        # ISSUE 32 FIX: use A3-A6 and scale 0.9 for better vertical/horizontal centering
        self.place_in_area(conclusion, "A3", "A6", scale_factor=0.9)
        
        # Visual celebratory glow on the curve cross-section
        ellipse_glow = plane_line.copy().set_stroke(color_conclusion, width=12, opacity=0.4)
        
        self.play(
            Write(conclusion),
            Create(ellipse_glow),
            p_tracker.animate.set_value(0.5),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section5Scene(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Layout (Title and Lecture Text)
        title_text = "Dandelin Spheres: The 3D Geometry"
        lecture_lines = [
            "1. Spheres touch the cone",
            "   at a circle.",
            "2. They touch the plane",
            "   at a single point.",
            "3. These points are the",
            "   foci of the ellipse."
        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title_text, lecture_lines)
        
        # 2. 3D Construction Area
        # We will use the right side of the screen for the 3D visualization.
        # Shift the camera to center the right side
        self.set_camera_orientation(phi=75 * DEGREES, theta=-45 * DEGREES)
        
        # Define 3D objects
        cone = Cone(base_radius=1.5, height=3, fill_opacity=0.3, color=BLUE)
        cone.shift(RIGHT * 3) # Move to the right side
        
        sphere = Sphere(radius=0.6, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8)
        sphere.move_to(cone.get_center() + UP * 0.2)
        
        plane = Plane(x_range=[-2, 2], y_range=[-2, 2], background_line_style={"stroke_opacity": 0.4})
        plane.rotate(30 * DEGREES, axis=RIGHT)
        plane.move_to(cone.get_center() + UP * 0.5)
        
        # Labels for 3D objects (using 2D labels projected/fixed)
        sphere_label = Text("Dandelin Sphere", font_size=18).next_to(sphere, RIGHT)

        # 3. Animations
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(self.title, self.lecture)
        
        self.play(Create(cone))
        self.play(FadeIn(sphere))
        self.play(Create(plane))
        self.begin_ambient_camera_rotation(rate=0.1)
        self.play(Write(sphere_label))
        self.wait(3)
        self.stop_ambient_camera_rotation()

    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        
        # Left-side lecture content
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        
        # Define animation grid (6x6) on the right side
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Offset x to the right side of the screen (approx 0 to 6 range)
                x_val = 1.0 + j * 0.8
                y_val = 2.0 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x_val, y_val, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        """Helper to place objects in the coordinate grid system."""
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        if grid_pos in self.grid:
            mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject
